key_notes: Key 1 (t=2.19s): Initial archival pose of crab; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=3.31s): Mid-sequence articulation of crab; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=4.55s): Peak dynamic extension of crab over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=5.79s): Follow-through and settle of crab with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of crab (2.19s..5.79s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
